name: bld5_isometry_compact_id_uniform_limit
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f) : ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => f^[φ k] x) id Filter.atTop
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : Isometry f), ∃ φ : ℕ → ℕ, StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => f^[φ k] x) id Filter.atTop
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld4_isometry_compact_uniform_recurrence: first upgrade to arbitrarily large return times: for ε > 0 and N ≥ 1, the bld4 theorem with ε/N gives n > 0 with dist(f^[n] x, x) < ε/N for all x; since f^[n] is an isometry, the triangle inequality gives dist(f^[nN] x, x) ≤ N·sup dist(f^[n] y, y) < ε with nN ≥ N. Then build φ recursively (φ(k+1) > φ(k) with sup-distance < 1/(k+2)) and unfold Metric.tendstoUniformly_iff.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), Isometry f → ∃ φ, StrictMono φ ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k x => f^[φ k] x) id Filter.atTop
